question: In what year was the actress who is starred as Baron Frankenstein's new creation in "Frankenstein Created Woman" born?

passages.title: Frankenstein Created Woman
passages.snippet: Frankenstein Created Woman Frankenstein Created Woman is a 1967 British Hammer Horror film directed by Terence Fisher.  It stars Peter Cushing as Baron Frankenstein and Susan Denberg as his new creation.  It is the fourth film in Hammer's Frankenstein series.

passages.title: Earl of Essex
passages.snippet: Earl of Essex Earl of Essex is a title in the Peerage of England which was first created in the 12th century by King Stephen of England.  The title has been recreated eight times from its original inception, beginning with a new first Earl upon each new creation. passages.snippet: Susan Denberg Susan Denberg (born Dietlinde Zechner; 2 August 1944, Bad Polzin, Germany) is a German-Austrian model and actress.
